carmen: will do. drafting a tiny rotation helper for Python (docs-only):
```python
# docs/snippets/rotate_helper.py
import threading
import time

def start_rotation(get_token, apply_token):
    stop = threading.Event()
    def _loop():
        while not stop.is_set():
            token = get_token()
            apply_token(token)
            stop.wait(50*60)  # refresh before 1h
    t = threading.Thread(target=_loop, daemon=True)
    t.start()
    return stop.set
```
